item.title: Meet Popcorn, the Children’s Hospital of Georgia’s newest facility dog
item.description: Last November, staff at the Wellstar Golisano Children’s Hospital of Georgia (CHOG) gave a hearty sendoff to Nugget, the golden retriever who helped launch the hospital’s service dog program. Now that she’s retired, there’s a new pup on the block eager to help comfort CHOG’s young patients. item.title: Augusta SWAT standoff ends in tragedy: Man dies from self-inflicted shot
item.description: An Augusta man died at the hospital Wednesday after shooting himself in the middle of a standoff with SWAT officers following a domestic call in the Sims Place neighborhood.
